manifest population equals exact legacy unittest discovery with zero omission and zero duplication
all four shadow shards pass independently
shadow aggregate outcome equals canonical full unittest outcome on the same candidate head
existing tests, pytest-unittest-parity and runner-parity checks pass
FINAL_HEAD/profile, canonical observer and stable-main readiness pass
no xdist, pytest-native admission, required-check substitution, benchmark-semantic change or scientific authority delta occurs
performance evidence records shard wall times, critical path and runner overhead
at least three comparable shadow executions are recorded where practicable before cutover recommendation
rollback: Remove or supersede only shadow-candidate machinery; preserve current required CI and all evidence.
